t: The OB1 Multi-Surface Sealant & Adhesive offers a robust hybrid polymer solution for professional bonding and sealing applications across various materials. This versatile product is suitable for both interior and exterior projects, making it ideal for plumbers, carpenters, and general builders requiring a reliable, durable fix. Its advanced solvent-free formulation ensures the sealant will not crack or shrink over time, providing a long-lasting, clear finish. Furthermore, the innovative compound allows application even on wet surfaces and provides excellent resistance to fungal and bacterial growth, maintaining a clean and professional appearance in areas like bathrooms and kitchens. It is also paintable and flexible.
b: Apply in Wet or Dry Conditions
